# Léim

> Léim (leim.ie) is online revision for Irish secondary school students, mapped to the official Junior Cycle and Leaving Cert specifications. Every topic has a free 60-second game, the rules and a printable practice sheet, with no login needed. Junior Cycle Spanish is complete (all 27 topics, an Exam Centre and a €10 Exam Pack for the June 2027 exam), Junior Cycle Maths is being added now, and English and Irish come next. Léim is built by a language teacher with over 25 years' experience. "Léim" is the Irish word for a leap.

Who it is for: Junior Cycle students (1st to 3rd year) revising Spanish and Maths, their parents, and secondary teachers looking for free class games and €5 printable teacher packs. Students do not need an account. Contact: hello@leim.ie. Shop: https://payhip.com/Leim. Sister site for primary school: https://spraoilearning.ie

## Start here
- [Junior Cycle subjects: Spanish and Maths](https://leim.ie/subjects.html): Choose a Junior Cycle subject on Léim: free revision games, rules and revision sheets mapped to the official specification.
- [Junior Cycle Spanish revision](https://leim.ie/junior-cycle-spanish.html): Junior Cycle Spanish revision mapped to the official specification: listening practice, model answers, self-marking quizzes and CBA guides for 1st, 2nd and 3rd year.
- [Junior Cycle Maths revision](https://leim.ie/junior-cycle-maths.html): Free Junior Cycle Maths revision games mapped to the 2018 specification: integers, BIMDAS and more, with rules, free printable sheets, an exam corner for every topic and a topic checklist for 1st to 3rd year.
- [Junior Cycle English revision](https://leim.ie/junior-cycle-english.html): Junior Cycle English mapped to the 2015 specification: how the 2-hour, 180-mark theme-based paper works, the two CBAs, the text-list rules and all 32 topics from 1st to 3rd year, with free games starting with Word Sort.
- [Junior Cycle Exam Centre: Spanish and Maths](https://leim.ie/exam-centre.html): Léim Exam Centre: the Junior Cycle Spanish and Maths papers explained, how they are marked, and strategies to win marks.
- [Junior Cycle Spanish Exam Centre: the paper, the marks, strategies](https://leim.ie/junior-cycle-spanish-exam-centre.html): Junior Cycle Spanish Exam Centre: the paper explained (360 marks: Listening 140, Reading 140, Writing 80), grade bands, where marks are won and lost, exam strategies, a model answer and a guide for parents.
- [Junior Cycle Spanish speaking: the oral CBA explained, with models](https://leim.ie/junior-cycle-spanish-speaking.html): How the Junior Cycle Spanish oral CBA works: timing, the four formats, what the teacher listens for, a 3-week plan, survival phrases and a model interview you can listen to.
- [Junior Cycle Maths Exam Centre: Higher and Ordinary papers, how they're marked, what to do if you go wrong](https://leim.ie/junior-cycle-maths-exam-centre.html): How the Junior Cycle Maths paper is marked at Higher and Ordinary level: 270 marks, 13 compulsory questions, marks per question, partial credit scales, slips and errors, crossed-out work, strategies and the new grade bands.
- [My Junior Cycle Spanish topic checklist](https://leim.ie/junior-cycle-spanish-checklist.html): Every Junior Cycle Spanish topic in teaching order, 1st to 3rd year, with learning outcome codes. Tick off the game, the rules and the revision sheet, and rate how confident you feel. Free, no login.
- [My Junior Cycle Maths topic checklist](https://leim.ie/junior-cycle-maths-checklist.html): Every Junior Cycle Maths topic in teaching order, 1st to 3rd year, with learning outcome codes. Tick off the game, the rules and the revision sheet, and rate how confident you feel. Free, no login.
- [My Junior Cycle English topic checklist](https://leim.ie/junior-cycle-english-checklist.html): Every Junior Cycle English topic in teaching order, 1st to 3rd year, with learning outcome codes and the two CBAs. Tick off the game, the rules and the revision sheet, and rate how confident you feel. Free, no login.

- [No Spanish at your school? How to take Junior Cycle Spanish anyway](https://leim.ie/junior-cycle-spanish-no-spanish-at-school.html): Your school doesn't teach Spanish? How a student can still study Junior Cycle Spanish and sit the exam: who enters them, the oral CBA, what goes on the JCPA, grades for 2027 and 2028, and a step-by-step plan for parents.
- [For teachers](https://leim.ie/teachers.html): Free Junior Cycle revision games and sheets for your class, plus €5 printable teacher packs mapped to the specification.
- [About](https://leim.ie/about.html): Léim is online revision for Irish secondary students, built by a language teacher with over 25 years' experience.

## Junior Cycle Spanish games
- [Describing people: play Agreement Snap](https://leim.ie/agreement-snap.html): Free Junior Cycle Spanish game: describe people in Spanish and make the adjectives agree (alto, alta, altos, altas), ser or tener for looks, with a Listening mode. Rules and a free printable below.
- [Food, drink & eating out: play Café Order Rush](https://leim.ie/cafe-order-rush.html): Free Junior Cycle Spanish game: food, drink and eating out. Read the order and serve the right tray, prices in euro, quisiera, la cuenta, de primero, meal times in Spain. With a Listening mode. Rules and a free printable below.
- [Linking & extending sentences: play Connector Chain](https://leim.ie/connector-chain.html): Free Junior Cycle Spanish game: linking and extending sentences. Join the sentence halves with y, pero, porque, así que, aunque, cuando, o and si and build a paragraph link by link; connectors toolkit, y → e and o → u, porque or ¿por qué?, también or tampoco, and a Listening mode. Rules and a free printable below.
- [Jobs & future plans: play Dream Job Match](https://leim.ie/dream-job-match.html): Free Junior Cycle Spanish game: jobs, future plans and me gustaría. Fill in a careers card line by line and find the dream job, jobs for men and women, workplaces, part-time jobs, me gustaría / quiero / voy a. With a Listening mode. Rules and a free printable below.
- [Me and my family: play Family Tree Detective](https://leim.ie/family-tree-detective.html): Free Junior Cycle Spanish game: family words, mi/mis and su/sus, tener for ages and pets. Read the clues, crack the family tree. Rules and a free printable below.
- [Spain and the Spanish-speaking world: play Fiesta Quiz](https://leim.ie/fiesta-quiz.html): Free Junior Cycle Spanish game: Spain and the Spanish-speaking world. Festivals, food, famous places and people in Spain and Latin America, countries, capitals and nationalities on the map, Spain and Ireland compared. With a Listening mode. Rules and a free printable below.
- [Messages, emails & forms: play Fix the Email](https://leim.ie/fix-the-email.html): Free Junior Cycle Spanish game: messages, emails and forms. Find and fix the mistakes in an email line by line, friend or formal?, email phrases, filling in a Spanish form, and a Listening mode with voicemails and email addresses. Rules and a free printable below.
- [Weather & seasons: play Forecast Match](https://leim.ie/forecast-match.html): Free Junior Cycle Spanish game: weather and seasons. Match the forecast to the weather card, hace, está or hay, temperatures, seasons and months, forecast words, and yesterday, today or tomorrow. With a Listening mode. Rules and a free printable below.
- [Nouns & articles: play Gender Sort](https://leim.ie/gender-sort.html): Free Junior Cycle Spanish game: nouns and articles. Swipe each noun to el or la, learn the endings and the exceptions (el día, la mano), make plurals (el lápiz → los lápices), pick un, una, unos or unas, and spot article slips. With a Listening mode. Rules and a free printable below.
- [Exam skills: listening & reading strategies: play Gist or Detail?](https://leim.ie/gist-or-detail.html): Free Junior Cycle Spanish exam-skills game: read short texts against the clock, get the gist, then find the details. Cognates and false friends, number traps, times, prices, dates, change-of-mind traps and a Listening mode. Strategies and a free printable below.
- [Free time, hobbies & sport: play Hobby Bingo](https://leim.ie/hobby-bingo.html): Free Junior Cycle Spanish game: free time, hobbies and sport. jugar a, hacer, ir a, tocar, how often, and opinions, with a Listening mode. Rules and a free printable below.
- [Directions and getting around in Spanish: play Map Dash](https://leim.ie/map-dash.html): Free Junior Cycle Spanish game: directions and getting around. Follow Spanish directions on a town map, sigue or siga (tú or usted), al or a la, signs at the station, transport and buying a ticket. With a Listening mode. Rules and a free printable below.
- [Greetings, introductions & classroom Spanish: play Meet & Greet](https://leim.ie/meet-and-greet.html): Free Junior Cycle Spanish game: greetings, introductions and classroom Spanish. Build a conversation line by line, sort tú or usted, pick buenos días, buenas tardes or buenas noches, and learn the phrases you need in class. With a Listening mode. Rules and a free printable below.
- [Numbers, age, dates and time: play Number Rush](https://leim.ie/number-rush.html): Free Junior Cycle Spanish game: numbers 0–100 and beyond, age with tener, birthdays and dates, telling the time, plus a Listening mode. Rules and a free printable below.
- [Likes, dislikes and opinions: play Opinion Dash](https://leim.ie/opinion-dash.html): Free Junior Cycle Spanish game: gusta or gustan, the opinion ladder and giving reasons with porque es / porque son. Rules and a free printable below.
- [Near future & making plans: play Plan It!](https://leim.ie/plan-it.html): Free Junior Cycle Spanish game: the near future (ir a + infinitive) and making plans. Build a text-message chat to plan the weekend, invite, accept or say no, arrange a time and place. With a Listening mode. Rules and a free printable below.
- [Holidays & travel: play Postcard Builder](https://leim.ie/postcard-builder.html): Free Junior Cycle Spanish game: holidays and travel. Build a holiday postcard line by line, transport, countries, places to stay, holiday activities, and past, present or future. With a Listening mode. Rules and a free printable below.
- [Shopping, clothes & prices: play Price Check](https://leim.ie/price-check.html): Free Junior Cycle Spanish game: shopping, clothes and prices. Read or hear the price and pick the right price tag, ¿cuánto cuesta o cuestan?, colours that agree, este / ese, más barato que, and phrases for the clothes shop. With a Listening mode. Rules and a free printable below.
- [Health and the body in Spanish: play ¿Qué te duele?](https://leim.ie/que-te-duele.html): Free Junior Cycle Spanish game: health and the body. Talk to a sick friend, the doctor and the chemist line by line, learn body parts, me duele or me duelen, tengo, estoy or me duele, and match problems to advice. With a Listening mode. Rules and a free printable below.
- [Asking questions in Spanish: play Question Quick-Fire](https://leim.ie/question-quick-fire.html): Free Junior Cycle Spanish game: asking questions. Build interviews question by question, pick the right question word (qué, dónde, cuándo, cuántos, cuál), write questions with no mistakes and answer them in full. With a Listening mode. Rules and a free printable below.
- [Where I live: house & town: play Room Raider](https://leim.ie/room-raider.html): Free Junior Cycle Spanish game: where I live, house and town. Find things with encima de, debajo de, entre; rooms, hay or está, places in town, al or a la, signs in Spain. With a Listening mode. Rules and a free printable below.
- [Daily routine & reflexive verbs: play Routine Order-Up](https://leim.ie/routine-order-up.html): Free Junior Cycle Spanish game: daily routine and reflexive verbs. Build a whole day line by line, me levanto, te duchas, se acuesta, stem changers, times, sequencers, and morning, afternoon or night? With a Listening mode. Rules and a free printable below.
- [Alphabet, sounds and spelling: play Sound Match](https://leim.ie/sound-match.html): Free Junior Cycle Spanish game: match Spanish sounds to spellings (j, g, c, z, ll, ñ, rr), the alphabet and spelling out names, accents and ¿ ¡, plus a Listening mode. Rules and a free printable below.
- [The past tense (preterite): play Time Machine](https://leim.ie/time-machine.html): Free Junior Cycle Spanish game: the past tense (preterite). Regular endings, fui, hice, tuve, estuve, vi, and past, present or future? With a Listening mode. Rules and a free printable below.
- [School & timetable: play Timetable Scramble](https://leim.ie/timetable-scramble.html): Free Junior Cycle Spanish game: school subjects, days, times and the timetable, opinions of subjects and teachers, with a Listening mode. Rules and a free printable below.
- [Present tense: revise and play Verb Sprint](https://leim.ie/verb-sprint.html): Free Junior Cycle Spanish game: pick the right present-tense verb form against the clock. Regular -ar, -er, -ir verbs and the key irregulars.
- [Ser, estar & hay: play Verb Swipe](https://leim.ie/verb-swipe.html): Free Junior Cycle Spanish game: ser, estar and hay. Swipe each sentence to SER, ESTAR or HAY, pick the right form, say why, and spot the words that change meaning (es aburrido / está aburrido). With a Listening mode. Rules and a free printable below.

## Junior Cycle Maths games
- [Angle Chase: Lines, Angles & Triangles Game](https://leim.ie/angle-chase.html): Free Junior Cycle Maths game: find missing angles and name the reason. Straight lines, vertically opposite, triangles, isosceles, exterior angles and parallel lines, with an exam corner.
- [Bracket Blaster: Expanding Brackets Game](https://leim.ie/bracket-blaster.html): Free Junior Cycle Maths game: expand and simplify brackets. One bracket, double brackets with the area model, squares, difference of two squares and spot-the-slip, with an exam corner.
- [Balance It: Linear Equations Game](https://leim.ie/balance-it.html): Free Junior Cycle Maths game: solve linear equations by keeping the scales level. One and two steps, letters on both sides, brackets, fractions, word problems and spot-the-slip, with an exam corner.
- [Power Up: Indices & Standard Form Game](https://leim.ie/power-up.html): Free Junior Cycle Maths game: powers, square roots, the laws of indices, BIMDAS and standard form, plus a Higher Level round on zero, negative and fractional indices, with an exam corner.
- [Shop Keeper: Money, Bills & VAT Game](https://leim.ie/shop-keeper.html): Free Junior Cycle Maths game: add up receipts and bills, add and remove VAT, sale prices, profit and loss, value for money, plus Higher Level mark-up and margin, with an exam corner.
- [Payslip Puzzle: Income Tax, Net Pay & Compound Interest Game](https://leim.ie/payslip-puzzle.html): Free Junior Cycle Maths game: gross and net pay, overtime, payslips, income tax and tax credits, and compound interest on savings and loans, plus Higher Level cut-off points and working backwards, with an exam corner.
- [Road Trip: Speed, Distance, Time & Currency Game](https://leim.ie/road-trip.html): Free Junior Cycle Maths game: speed, distance and time, arrival times, average speed, distance-time graphs and currency conversion with euro, sterling and dollars, with an exam corner.
- [Floor Planner: Area, Perimeter & Scale Drawings Game](https://leim.ie/floor-planner.html): Free Junior Cycle Maths game: perimeter and area of rectangles, L-shapes, triangles, parallelograms and circles, π, semicircles, pricing a floor and scale drawings, with an exam corner.
- [Average Ace: Charts, Graphs & Averages Game](https://leim.ie/average-ace.html): Free Junior Cycle Maths game: mean, median, mode and range, bar charts, pie charts, line plots, histograms, stem-and-leaf and back-to-back plots, choosing the best display and spotting misleading charts, with an exam corner.
- [Mirror Move: Transformations & Symmetry Game](https://leim.ie/mirror-move.html): Free Junior Cycle Maths game: axial symmetry, central symmetry, translations and rotations on a coordinate grid, naming the transformation and axes of symmetry, with an exam corner.
- [Proof Builder: Theorems, Congruent & Similar Triangles Game](https://leim.ie/proof-builder.html): Free Junior Cycle Maths game: fill the gaps in geometry proofs, parallelograms, the angle in a semicircle, congruent triangles (SSS, SAS, ASA, RHS) and similar triangles, plus Higher Level circle theorems, with an exam corner.
- [Ladder Lab: Pythagoras' Theorem Game](https://leim.ie/ladder-lab.html): Free Junior Cycle Maths game: find the hypotenuse and the shorter sides of right-angled triangles, test whether a triangle is right-angled with the converse, square roots, ladders, screens and shortcuts, with an exam corner.
- [Coin & Dice Lab: Relative Frequency & Counting Game](https://leim.ie/coin-dice-lab.html): Free Junior Cycle Maths game: relative frequency from experiments, expected frequency, fair or biased dice and spinners, and the fundamental principle of counting for menus, outfits and codes, with an exam corner.
- [Factor Match: Factorising Game](https://leim.ie/factor-match.html): Free Junior Cycle Maths game: factorise by taking out the highest common factor, by grouping, quadratic trinomials x² + bx + c and the difference of two squares, plus Higher Level ax² + bx + c, with an exam corner.
- [Line Lab: Coordinate Geometry of the Line Game](https://leim.ie/line-lab.html): Free Junior Cycle Maths game: slope, midpoint and distance, y = mx + c and the equation of a line, parallel lines and where lines meet, plus Higher Level perpendicular lines, with an exam corner.
- [Two-Line Crossing: Simultaneous Equations Game](https://leim.ie/two-line-crossing.html): Free Junior Cycle Maths game: solve simultaneous equations by elimination, substitution and graphs, check a solution, spot the first mistake and solve word problems, plus Higher Level fractions, with an exam corner.
- [Root Rush: Quadratic Equations Game](https://leim.ie/root-rush.html): Free Junior Cycle Maths game: solve quadratic equations by factorising, find the roots, write the equation from its roots and solve area, number and ball word problems, plus Higher Level 2x² and the formula, with an exam corner.
- [Graph Match: Functions & Graphs Game](https://leim.ie/graph-match.html): Free Junior Cycle Maths game: f(x) notation, mapping diagrams, reading roots and turning points from graphs, story graphs and linear, quadratic or exponential, plus Higher Level f(x) = g(x), with an exam corner.
- [Clinometer Challenge: Trigonometry Game](https://leim.ie/clinometer-challenge.html): Free Junior Cycle Maths game: sin, cos and tan with SOH CAH TOA, find a side, find an angle with sin⁻¹, cos⁻¹ and tan⁻¹, angles of elevation and depression, plus Higher Level two-step problems, with an exam corner.
- [Pack It: Volume, Surface Area & Nets Game](https://leim.ie/pack-it.html): Free Junior Cycle Maths game: volume and surface area of cuboids, prisms, cylinders, spheres and hemispheres, nets, how many boxes fit, litres and water rising, plus Higher Level working backwards, with an exam corner.
- [Number-Line Shade: Inequalities Game](https://leim.ie/number-line-shade.html): Free Junior Cycle Maths game: inequalities on a number line (open and closed dots, ℕ, ℤ and ℝ), solving linear inequalities, whole-number answers, real-life problems and graphs, plus Higher Level flips and double inequalities, with an exam corner.
- [Rearrange Race: Algebraic Fractions, Long Division & Changing the Subject Game](https://leim.ie/rearrange-race.html): Free Junior Cycle Maths game: changing the subject of a formula, adding and subtracting algebraic fractions and dividing a quadratic by a bracket, plus Higher Level square-root formulas, x on the bottom and cubics.
- [Growth Spotter: Quadratic & Exponential Patterns Game](https://leim.ie/growth-spotter.html): Free Junior Cycle Maths game: linear, quadratic or exponential patterns, 1st and 2nd differences, growing tile patterns, doubling and tripling, plus Higher Level general terms (an² + bn + c). Rules, exam-style questions and a free printable sheet.
- [Surd Simplify: Surds Game](https://leim.ie/surd-simplify.html): Free Junior Cycle Maths game: simplify surds (√72 = 6√2), add like surds, multiply, divide and square surds, plus Higher Level brackets with surds. Rules, exam-style questions and a free printable sheet.
- [Exam Mix: Junior Cycle Maths Problem Solving & Exam Practice Game](https://leim.ie/exam-mix.html): Free Junior Cycle Maths exam practice: questions from all 37 topics mixed like the real paper, plus two-step problem solving (U.5–U.10). Exam tips, original exam-style questions and a free printable sheet.
- [Word Sort: Parts of Speech Game](https://leim.ie/word-sort.html): Free Junior Cycle English game: sort nouns, verbs, adjectives and adverbs, find pronouns, prepositions and conjunctions, spot words that change class and pick stronger words. Rules, exam-style questions with model answers and a free printable sheet.
- [Sentence Surgeon: Sentences, Fragments and Run-ons](https://leim.ie/sentence-surgeon.html): Free Junior Cycle English game: tell sentences from fragments and run-ons, fix comma splices, pick joining words, the four sentence types and simple / compound / complex sentences. Rules, exam-style questions with model answers and a free printable sheet.
- [Comma Catch: Punctuation Game](https://leim.ie/comma-catch.html): Free Junior Cycle English game: commas in lists, after openers and around names, capital letters, apostrophes (dog's or dogs'?), its or it's, and full stops, question and exclamation marks. Rules, exam corner and a printable practice sheet.
- [Clue Hunt: Reading Comprehension Game](https://leim.ie/clue-hunt.html): Free Junior Cycle English game: short original texts with numbered lines. Find the line that proves it, scan for a fact, pick the best title, read between the lines (how do they feel?), and fact or opinion. Rules, exam corner with model answers and a printable practice sheet.
- [Character Clues: Novel Character Game](https://leim.ie/character-clues.html): Free Junior Cycle English game on character: short original story moments. Find the line that shows a trait, STEAL (speech, thoughts, effect on others, actions, looks), pick the trait word and the best quote. Rules, exam corner with model answers and a printable practice sheet.
- [Spell Strike: Spelling Game](https://leim.ie/spell-strike.html): Free Junior Cycle English spelling game: tricky words, commonly confused words (there/their/they're, your/you're, to/too/two, could have, than/then), plurals and adding endings. Rules with memory tricks, exam corner with model answers and a printable practice sheet.
- [Paragraph Builder: Paragraphs & Topic Sentences Game](https://leim.ie/paragraph-builder.html): Free Junior Cycle English game on paragraphs: find the topic sentence, spot the sentence that doesn't belong, put a paragraph in order, when to start a new paragraph (TiPToP) and linking words. Rules, exam corner with model answers and a printable practice sheet.
- [Technique Spotter: Poetry Techniques Game](https://leim.ie/technique-spotter.html): Free Junior Cycle English game on poetry: spot simile, metaphor, personification, alliteration, onomatopoeia and rhyme, find them in short poems, the five senses (imagery), what's compared, and rhyme by sound. Rules, exam corner with model answers and a printable practice sheet.
- [Show, Don't Tell: Descriptive Writing Game](https://leim.ie/show-dont-tell.html): Free Junior Cycle English game on personal and descriptive writing: show a feeling instead of naming it, which feeling is shown, the five senses, strong verbs (walked → trudged, crept) and zooming in on specific details. Rules, exam corner with model answers and a printable practice sheet.
- [Talk Tips: Speaking & Listening Game](https://leim.ie/talk-tips.html): Free Junior Cycle English game on speaking and listening: good talk habits, hooks for an opening line (question, fact, story), signpost words, listening replies and polite discussion phrases. Rules, exam corner with model answers and a printable practice sheet.
- [Twist Detector: Short Stories Game](https://leim.ie/twist-detector.html): Free Junior Cycle English game on short stories: spot the twist ending and the clue that set it up, name the setting, problem, climax and ending, order a plot, pick a strong first line (dialogue, action, mystery) and read setting clue words. Rules, exam corner with model answers and a printable practice sheet.
- [Story Spine: Narrative Writing Game](https://leim.ie/story-spine.html): Free Junior Cycle English game on narrative writing: plan a story with a story spine (Once upon a time, Every day, But one day, Because of that, Until finally), cut events that don't belong, tell first-person from third-person narrators, keep the tense and narrator steady and pick an ending that solves the problem. Rules, exam corner with model answers and a printable practice sheet.
- [Word Ladder: Vocabulary & Dictionary Skills Game](https://leim.ie/word-ladder.html): Free Junior Cycle English game on vocabulary: put words on a ladder from weakest to strongest, swap "very" + a weak word for one strong word, tell synonyms from antonyms, build words with prefixes (un-, dis-, im-, il-, ir-, re-, mis-, pre-), pick the right word from a word family, and use ABC order, guide words and multiple meanings like a dictionary. Rules, exam corner with model answers and a printable practice sheet.
- [Plot Line: Novel Plot, Setting & Theme Game](https://leim.ie/plot-line.html): Free Junior Cycle English game on the novel: name the five stages of a plot (exposition, rising action, climax, falling action, resolution), put key moments in order, say what mood a setting creates, spot the theme of a moment (friendship, courage, loss, belonging, growing up, fairness, forgiveness) and how a character changes from start to end. Works with any novel. Rules, exam corner with model answers and a printable practice sheet.
- [Format Fixer: Letters & Emails Game](https://leim.ie/format-fixer.html): Free Junior Cycle English game on letters and emails: tell formal from informal lines, match the sign-off to the greeting (Yours faithfully, Yours sincerely or a friendly sign-off), name the parts of a formal letter and put them in order (your address, date, their address, greeting, opening line, closing line, sign-off), rewrite casual lines in a formal register, and spot what's missing from a letter or email. Rules, exam corner with model answers and a printable practice sheet.
- [Register Switch: Register & Tone Game](https://leim.ie/register-switch.html): Free Junior Cycle English game on register and tone: pick the line that suits the reader (a principal, a newspaper editor, the council, or a friend, Gran or your team chat), tell polite requests from blunt orders, turn an order into a polite request, name the tone of a line (cheerful, sad, angry or worried) and spot the slang word in a formal sentence. Rules, exam corner with model answers and a printable practice sheet.
- [Tense Trap: Tenses, Agreement & Pronouns Game](https://leim.ie/tense-trap.html): Free Junior Cycle English game on grammar: pick the verb that fits the time word (yesterday, every day, tomorrow), find the verb that slipped out of the past in a short story, make verbs agree with tricky subjects (each of, one of, there are), choose saw or seen, did or done, and choose I or me. Rules, exam corner with model answers and a printable practice sheet.
- [Persuasion Power: Persuasive Writing & Speeches Game](https://leim.ie/persuasion-power.html): Free Junior Cycle English game on persuasive writing and speeches: name the technique (rhetorical question, rule of three, statistic, emotive language, direct address, repetition), pick the reason that backs up a point, answer the other side politely, and choose a strong call to action. Rules, exam corner with model answers and a printable practice sheet.
- [Ad Breaker: Advertising and Media Game](https://leim.ie/ad-breaker.html): Free Junior Cycle English game on advertising: spot the trick (star power, free gift, bandwagon, statistic, exaggeration, hurry), work out who an ad is aimed at, sort fact from opinion, pick the best slogan and say what the picture suggests. Rules, exam corner with model answers and a printable practice sheet.
- [Stage It: Drama and Stagecraft Game](https://leim.ie/stage-it.html): Free Junior Cycle English game on how plays work: choose the lighting and sound for a scene, say what a stage direction tells the actor, sort set, costume, lighting, sound and props, name the conflict and read how a character feels from the stage directions. Rules, exam corner with model answers and a printable practice sheet.
- [Format Sort: Reports, Reviews, Articles and Blogs Game](https://leim.ie/format-sort.html): Free Junior Cycle English functional writing game: tell a report, review, article, blog or speech apart from one line, pick the best headline for a news story, and sort the parts of a report (title, introduction, findings, recommendations, sign-off) and a review (details, praise, criticism, verdict). Rules, exam corner with model answers and a printable practice sheet.
- [Mood Match: Poetry Theme, Tone and Comparing Poems Game](https://leim.ie/mood-match.html): Free Junior Cycle English poetry game: name the mood of a short poem (joyful, sad, peaceful, tense, angry, nostalgic), find the word that sets it, name the theme (friendship, loss, nature, home and place, growing up), spot where the mood turns, and compare two poems on the same theme. Rules, exam corner with model answers and a printable practice sheet.
- [Speech Marks Sprint: Dialogue, Colons and Semicolons Game](https://leim.ie/speech-marks-sprint.html): Free Junior Cycle English punctuation game: set out dialogue with speech marks (the mark inside, a capital to start, a new line for each speaker), pick the comma, full stop, question mark or exclamation mark that goes inside, choose a colon or a semicolon, and turn direct speech into reported speech. Rules, exam corner with model answers and a printable practice sheet.
- [Proofread Patrol: Editing and Proofreading Game](https://leim.ie/proofread-patrol.html): Free Junior Cycle English editing game: tap the spelling, mix-up or grammar slip in a sentence, count the slips in a short passage, choose fewer or less and who or whom, and use brackets and dashes in pairs. Rules (four proofreading passes, redrafting), exam corner with model answers and a printable practice sheet.
- [Shot Spotter: Film Camera Shots, Sound and Editing Game](https://leim.ie/shot-spotter.html): Free Junior Cycle English film game: name the camera shot (extreme long shot to extreme close-up) and the camera angle from a drawn frame, pick the shot or angle that does a job, tell diegetic sound from the soundtrack, choose music for a scene, and spot quick cuts, slow motion, flashbacks, fades and montages. Rules (writing about a key scene: name it, describe it, say what it does), exam corner with model answers and a printable practice sheet.
- [Who Said It? Shakespeare Quotes Game (Higher Level)](https://leim.ie/who-said-it.html): Free Junior Cycle English Higher Level Shakespeare game: match famous lines from Romeo and Juliet, The Merchant of Venice and Julius Caesar to the character (every line checked against the text of the play), put key moments in order, crack old words (thou, wherefore, hath) and name the technique (oxymoron, simile, rhyming couplet, rhetorical question). Rules (verse and prose, soliloquy, aside, dramatic irony, point-quote-explain), exam corner on Mercutio's death with model answers and a printable practice sheet.
- [Clock Dash: Units, Time & Timetables Game](https://leim.ie/clock-dash.html): Free Junior Cycle Maths game on units of measure and time: 24-hour clock, reading clocks, time differences, km/kg/litre conversions, hours and minutes, and bus timetables. Rules, exam corner and a free printable.
- [Construction Steps: Constructions Game](https://leim.ie/construction-steps.html): Free Junior Cycle Maths game: watch each construction drawn step by step and pick the next step. Bisectors, perpendiculars, parallel lines, equal parts, angles and SSS, SAS, ASA, RHS triangles, with an exam corner.
- [Data Detective: Statistics Game](https://leim.ie/data-detective.html): Free Junior Cycle Maths statistics game: sort categorical and numerical data, spot biased questions and samples, read tally marks and frequency tables, and plan a statistical investigation for CBA 2.

- [Like-Term Sweep: algebra, like terms & substitution game](https://leim.ie/like-term-sweep.html): Free Junior Cycle Maths game: collect like terms, write expressions from words, substitute negative numbers and spot equal expressions, with the rules and an Exam corner. AF.2a, AF.2b, AF.3a.
- [Pattern Builder: Linear Patterns & Sequences Game](https://leim.ie/pattern-builder.html): Free Junior Cycle Maths game: continue matchstick and tile patterns, find the general term Tₙ, read tables and graphs, start value and rate of change. Rules and exam-style questions included.
